baseline_models.focus_anchor: The active participle from ل ق ي takes ذ ك ر as its delivered content.
baseline_models.mechanism: A plural agency transfers speech into a recipient's hearing so that voiced content becomes a reminder rather than remaining private knowledge.

activation_trace.role: The speech-transfer branch makes the participle a communicative handoff that can impart recited or taught words.
The spoken-mention branch supplies overtly voiced content for the handoff.
The reminder branch gives the delivered speech its recollective and admonitory effect.

changed_reading.before: Plural agents cast an unspecified thing called remembrance.
changed_reading.after: Plural agents perform a speech handoff whose content is meant to restore a matter to active awareness.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction pairs a casting participle from ل ق ي with the accusative ذ ك ر.
baseline_models.mechanism: The reminder is objectified as a payload placed before or upon recipients, giving communication direction, force, and a point of arrival.

activation_trace.role: The casting branch supplies directed placement of an object before or upon another.
The reminder branch identifies the cast payload as something that reactualizes awareness.

changed_reading.before: The phrase merely denotes giving a reminder.
changed_reading.after: It depicts reminder as a directed payload deliberately set in a recipient's path.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ل ق ي inventory includes meeting and making two sides meet, while ذ ك ر includes bringing something back to mind.
baseline_models.mechanism: Casting is read causatively as bringing recipient and remembered matter face to face; the act does not only transmit information but stages an encounter with what was absent from attention.

activation_trace.role: The meeting branch supplies the face-to-face relation produced by the casting.
The joining branch permits the agent's act to be modeled as causing two previously separated sides to meet.
The recollection branch supplies the absent matter that is brought back into mental presence.

changed_reading.before: Reminder is content sent from one party to another.
changed_reading.after: Reminder is an arranged encounter between a recipient and a reality returned to presence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus act becomes the terminal handoff in an ordered process: dispatch in connected succession, forceful movement, spreading, differentiation, and finally placement of reminder. This retains uncertainty about whether one agency performs every stage.

activation_trace.role: Directed casting supplies the final placement operation in the proposed chain.
Reminder is the chain's delivered output rather than a free-standing topic.
Dispatch and outward impulsion initiate the process that reaches the focus act.
Connected succession supplies ordered continuity between the dispatched units.
A force that lifts and scatters supplies the chain's energetic movement.
Opening, extending, and branching supply distribution before the handoff.
Discrimination between things supplies a sorting stage immediately before reminder is cast.

structural_cues: 77:1-5 is an uninterrupted sequence of feminine plural participles linked by coordinating particles.
The emphatic cognate accusatives in 77:2-4 make the pre-focus operations read as an intensifying series.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered forms and branch images; I add the directional arrow that treats them as stages whose output is the focus reminder. They may instead be coordinated but independent oath referents.

changed_reading.before: The focus phrase names an isolated class of reminder-bearers.
changed_reading.after: It names the delivery phase in a distributed process that sends, drives, spreads, sorts, and deposits reminder.

context_deltas.mechanism: The cast reminder has two explicitly adjacent pragmatic outcomes: it can establish or complete an excuse, or it can awaken caution through warning. The focus act is therefore functional notice, not generic recollection.

activation_trace.role: Speech transfer supplies the communicative act whose consequences are specified next.
Admonitory recall supplies content capable of changing the hearer's accountability or caution.
Giving full notice until an excuse is reached supplies one possible legal-pragmatic outcome.
Warning that arouses caution supplies the alternative preventive outcome.

structural_cues: 77:6 immediately follows the focus phrase and coordinates two accusative outcomes with an explicit alternative marker.
The absence of a new finite predicate lets both outcomes attach naturally to the preceding delivery sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacency, coordination, and the two outcome images; I assign those outcomes to the delivered reminder. A live alternative is that they characterize the entire opening chain rather than the focus act alone.

changed_reading.before: The agents transmit a generally beneficial reminder.
changed_reading.after: They issue consequential notice that either completes the space for excuse or activates warning.

context_deltas.mechanism: Reminder makes an appointed future event present in advance. The promised matter is already characterized as falling into fixed actuality, assigned a limit, and culminating in adjudicative separation, so the speech stages a preliminary encounter with what recipients will later meet materially.

activation_trace.role: The meeting branch frames reminder as advance face-to-face contact with its referent.
The branch of encountering good or ill lets the reminder anticipate an eventual lived encounter.
Mental re-presencing supplies the mode by which a future reality becomes active now.
A promise bounded by time or place supplies the future referent toward which reminder points.
Falling and becoming fixed supplies the promised event's transition from speech into actuality.
Assignment to a time or limit gives the encounter a fixed temporal boundary.
Judgment separating true from false supplies the event's adjudicative function.

structural_cues: 77:7 asserts certainty, 77:8-11 unfolds event transformations, and 77:12-14 names the appointed day.
The movement from promise to occurrence follows immediately after the reminder's excuse-or-warning function.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies promise, fixed occurrence, timing, and separation; I add the temporal-folding arrow by which reminder becomes an advance encounter. It may more conservatively be a report about the event rather than a preliminary form of it.

changed_reading.before: Reminder retrieves information that recipients might forget.
changed_reading.after: Reminder brings recipients into anticipatory contact with an already appointed encounter that speech will become.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus inventory's conception and womb-passage images become active beside the creation sequence: generative fluid is formed, lodged in a stable place, held to a measured limit, and later echoed by earth's gathering capacity. Reminder can thus be imagined as a deposited seed of recollection whose effect matures rather than an utterance exhausted at delivery.

activation_trace.role: The conception branch licenses a generative rather than merely ballistic model of delivery.
The specialized passage and junction branch supplies a bodily channel and receiving-place image.
Recollection supplies the latent content that can return to active presence after deposition.
Bringing a formed creature into existence supplies the process's generative endpoint.
Generative fluid placed in a womb supplies the material-deposition analogue.
Stability and settlement supply retention after the deposit arrives.
A place of being supplies the protected receptacle in which development can occur.
A measure that carries something to its limit supplies maturation toward a due boundary.
Gathering and enclosing in a receptacle extends the retention image from womb to earth.

structural_cues: 77:20-23 moves from origin in fluid through placement in a secure repository to a known measure.
77:25-26 repeats containment at terrestrial scale by pairing earth's gathering role with living and dead.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the focus root's generative branches and the later deposit-retention sequence; I transfer that process onto reminder and infer delayed maturation. The live alternative is only a cross-domain resonance, not a claim about the agents' identity or the noun's direct sense.

changed_reading.before: A reminder is delivered and complete at the moment of utterance.
changed_reading.after: A reminder is deposited as generative material that can be retained until recollection matures into presence and response.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier immaterial casting is reversed after denial: recipients are released toward what they rejected, while fire becomes the later casting subject and sparks its material payload. The focus warning is thereby the first, avoidable half of a trajectory whose second half is an inescapable encounter.

activation_trace.role: Directed casting supplies the initial communicative action that the later material action reverses.
Encounter with ill supplies the endpoint reached after the warning is refused.
Warning-reminder is the nonmaterial payload available before the reversal.
Attributing the warned matter to falsehood supplies the rejection that turns notice into encounter.
Unrestrained departure supplies compelled movement toward the denied referent.
Material throwing supplies the reversed action with fire as agent.
Flying fire fragments supply the later action's tangible payload.

structural_cues: 77:29 commands movement toward the very object previously denied, and 77:30 repeats the movement command.
77:32 gives a new subject a transitive throwing action and a concrete object, mirroring the focus construction functionally despite different roots.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denial, compelled movement, and fire's throwing; I add the retributive reversal linking that material casting to the focus casting. Because the verbs use different roots, a thematic parallel rather than a deliberate lexical echo remains possible.

changed_reading.before: The reminder is a warning projected outward for optional reception.
changed_reading.after: It is the merciful first casting in a reversal: rejecting its payload leaves recipients to meet the later payload cast by fire.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus delivery becomes timely notice entered while response is possible. Later, speech is unavailable, permission is withheld, and excuse cannot be performed; the earlier reminder therefore acquires a forensic function as notice that precedes closure of the response window.

activation_trace.role: Placement before another supplies the lodging of notice while it can still be answered.
The document-of-right branch supplies an exploratory record or notice function.
The explicit loss of speech marks closure of verbal response.
Withheld permission blocks any attempt to reopen the communicative exchange.
The unavailable excuse supplies the legal consequence of having passed the response window.

structural_cues: The excuse root first appears directly after the focus in 77:6 and returns under negation in 77:36.
77:35-38 places speech closure immediately before gathering on the day of separation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies early excuse, later silence, withheld permission, and failed excuse; I infer that the focus delivery serves as prior notice and record. A live alternative is a simple contrast between present warning and future inability without documentary force.

changed_reading.before: Reminder seeks recollection in an open-ended conversation.
changed_reading.after: Reminder is timely notice lodged before the finite opportunity to answer and excuse oneself closes.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sequence tests communication by embodied and inward reception: a saying calls for lowered posture, refusal exposes failed uptake, and the final question denies that any later discourse will secure settled assent. The focus reminder is thus a decisive speech-act threshold, not neutral information.

activation_trace.role: Imparted speech supplies the address whose uptake is tested at the surah's close.
Admonitory recall supplies speech intended to produce response, not mere recognition.
Audible utterance supplies the explicit summons against which reception is measured.
Humbling oneself supplies the embodied response requested and then refused.
Renewed report or discourse supplies the hypothetical later communication.
Temporal after-ness marks this reminder as the decisive boundary beyond which no better discourse remains.
Heart-settling assent supplies the inward uptake that later discourse will not achieve.

structural_cues: 77:48 pairs reported speech, an imperative, and repeated refusal within one ayah.
77:50 closes the surah by asking what discourse after this could produce belief.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies utterance, bodily refusal, later discourse, and belief; I infer that the focus reminder is the tested speech threshold connecting them. The bowing command may instead exemplify a broader refusal without referring specifically back to the focus act.

changed_reading.before: The reminder succeeds if its proposition is heard or mentally recalled.
changed_reading.after: The reminder is a final summons whose reception is measured by humbled action and settled trust, not exposure alone.

context_deltas.mechanism: The whole-surah refrain makes reminder iterative. Successive blocks repeatedly return denial and consequence to awareness, so the discourse itself performs repeated castings into resistance rather than only reporting a one-time delivery by unnamed agents.

activation_trace.role: Repeated imparting of speech supplies a performative model for the surah's successive warning units.
Repeated reactualization of a matter supplies the refrain's mnemonic function.
The first refrain names resistant rejection as the target into which reminder is repeatedly delivered.
The final recurrence shows that the same resistant posture is readdressed across the surah.

structural_cues: The same warning refrain recurs ten times from 77:15 through 77:49.
Each recurrence follows a different evidentiary, punitive, or reward scene, repeatedly recasting the warning with new content.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact refrain recurrence and varied intervening blocks; I attribute a performative casting function to that architecture. The refrain may instead reinforce a casting performed by external agents without itself instantiating the focus participle.

changed_reading.before: The focus points only to agents who delivered reminder before the discourse began.
changed_reading.after: The surah's recurring units can themselves enact plural, successive deliveries of reminder against persistent denial.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the legal-instrument branch of ذ ك ر is remote from ordinary reminder language and the ayah names no document. It remains anchored in the direct pairing of casting with that attested branch and gains coherence from later adjudication and settlement; downstream prose should present it only as a latent juridical image, not as a lexical replacement.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus combines object-placement from ل ق ي with the deed-or-rights-instrument branch of ذ ك ر.

activation_trace.role: Placement before another supplies the act of lodging or entering an instrument.
The specialized deed branch supplies a record of claim or right as the cast object.
Adjudication between true and false supplies the forum in which such a lodged claim matters.
Settlement and full collection of an obligation supply the record's eventual enforcement.

changed_reading.before: The agents cast an oral reminder.
changed_reading.after: They can be heard, exploratorily, as lodging a claim-record that will be adjudicated and settled.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation reverses the active participle toward a form-distant cast-off-object branch, so it cannot control the grammar. It remains useful because repeated denial supplies the social action that makes delivered reminder treated as discarded; render it as a shadow or consequence of reception, never as the direct parsing of the participle.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The ل ق ي root of the active participle also carries a branch for an abandoned cast-off object, while ذ ك ر supplies the reminder being treated that way.

activation_trace.role: The cast-off-object branch supplies the reminder's rejected social status after delivery.
The admonitory object is what recipients repeatedly refuse to retain.
Attribution to falsehood begins the recurring pattern of discarding the delivered warning.
The last refrain confirms sustained rejection rather than an isolated failure of uptake.

changed_reading.before: The reminder is successfully placed before recipients.
changed_reading.after: The same act carries a shadow outcome in which recipients convert the delivered reminder into something socially cast off.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The force-and-hardness branch of ذ ك ر is etymologically live but semantically distant from recollection, and the surrounding destructive images do not authorize translating reminder as a weapon. It remains anchored as a texture for how the cast reminder strikes resistance; downstream prose should qualify it as an affective-material resonance only.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus casts ذ ك ر, whose inventory includes a hard, sharp, forceful branch alongside recollection.

activation_trace.role: Directed casting supplies impact and trajectory for the reminder's forceful texture.
The hard and sharp branch supplies severity without replacing the reminder sense.
Overwhelming force supplies a nearby register of destructive intensity.
Striking or throwing supplies a later material analogue for severe impact.
Material projection confirms that casting can become an image of force within the surah.

changed_reading.after: Reminder also carries an exploratory hard-edged force: it is cast to strike through resistance, while remaining reminder rather than weapon.

strongest_changes: The immediate excuse-or-warning pair turns reminder into consequential notice with two pragmatic outcomes.
Promise, fixed occurrence, timing, and separation turn recollection into advance encounter with an appointed event.
The later loss of speech and the closing belief question make the delivery a finite response threshold rather than open-ended information.
The command toward what was denied and fire's later throwing reverse the focus casting from avoidable speech into material encounter.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah package activated mechanisms unavailable to a narrow local window: a creation-and-containment analogy for deposited reminder, a long-range reversal of casting agency, repeated closure of excuse, and the refrain's performance of successive reminder deliveries.
remaining_uncertainties: The feminine plural agents remain deliberately unidentified, and the opening forms may be sequential stages or coordinated independent referents.
The generative, juridical, cast-off, and hard-edged readings are branch-anchored resonances rather than secure direct senses of the focus construction.
The spark reversal is functional rather than lexical because the later throwing uses a different root.
The closing bowing command may test the focus reminder specifically or may exemplify a broader pattern of refusal.
